title: UrbanPulse Edge Event
description: Single source of truth for the edge -> central contract. Edge validates on write, central validates on ingest. Version this file; never change a field's meaning in place.

event_id.description: Generated on the EDGE. Doubles as the ingest idempotency key so retries after a dropped ACK cannot duplicate.

device_id.description: Stable edge node identity, e.g. 'bus-KA01F1234'. Bound to the signing key in the device registry.

route_id.description: GTFS route id, for route-delay analytics.

trip_id.description: GTFS trip id - one bus run.

captured_at.description: UTC, from the edge clock. May be far behind ingest time after a dead-zone buffer flush - never assume captured_at ~ now.

ingested_at.description: Set by central on receipt. Null on the wire. (ingested_at - captured_at) is the store-and-forward latency metric for Module 11.

confidence.description: Raw model confidence. Distinct from fused confidence, which central owns.

bbox_px.description: [x, y, w, h] top-left origin, pixels.

frame_size.description: [width, height] - required to interpret bbox_px across differing camera resolutions.

track_id.description: Tracker id, scoped to this device+camera+trip. Not globally unique.

model_id.description: e.g. 'yolo-infra-v3-int8'. Needed to attribute accuracy regressions to a model version.

geometry.description: Road-plane measurements from the IPM layer. Null when the camera is uncalibrated - consumers MUST handle null and fall back to bus position.

lateral_m.description: Metres right of bus centreline; negative = left.

forward_m.description: Metres ahead of the camera along the road plane.

estimated_size_m2.description: Physical footprint. THE severity input - scale-invariant, unlike bbox area.

range_confidence.description: Degrades with forward_m; the flat-road assumption breaks at distance and on gradients.

heading_deg.description: Required to project the subject position from road-plane offsets.

fix_age_s.description: Age of the GPS fix at capture. Dominates localization error at 1 Hz.

subject.description: Where the detected THING is, not where the bus was. bus_pos + R(heading)*(lateral, forward), then map-matched. This is what fusion clusters on.

error_m.description: Propagated estimate. Feeds the DBSCAN eps choice.

traffic_state.description: Populated for event_type=traffic_state. Density is per-lane-100m, NOT per-frame - frame counts are not comparable across cameras or speeds.

anpr.description: Only for driving_incident events, and only within OCR-readable range. plate_text is null unless the incident is authority-flagged; the hash always travels, the plaintext does not.

plate_text.description: Normally NULL on the wire. Plaintext lives only inside sealed_evidence.

plate_token.description: HMAC-SHA256(normalized_plate, daily_rotating_salt)[:16]. Irreversible; enables O-D matching without identity.

aggregate_confidence.description: From multi-frame voting - the PS-mandated confidence score.

frames_voted.description: Reads combined across the track. A judge will ask for this number.

wrapped_key.description: Content key under the command centre public key. The edge cannot decrypt its own evidence.

crop_ref.description: Object-store key or inline base64 for small crops.

crop_sha256.description: Covered by the integrity signature, so evidence cannot be swapped post-hoc.

clip_ref.description: Set only for high-confidence incidents. Sourced from the pre-trigger ring buffer.

plates_blurred.description: Non-flagged plates. Counts make anonymization auditable rather than merely asserted.

applied_before_persist.description: Must be true. Blurring after a disk write breaks the chain-of-custody claim.

seq.description: Per-device monotonic counter. A gap means loss or tampering, so central can detect deletion.

prev_hash.description: chain_hash of seq-1. Null only for seq 0.

payload_hash.description: SHA256 over CANONICAL json (sorted keys, fixed separators) of the event minus this block. Non-canonical serialization silently breaks verification.

key_id.description: Device key identifier, resolved against the central device registry.
